Heard Mr. M. Gogoi, learned counsel for the petitioner.

Also heard Mr. P.
Borthakur, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State of Assam.
Apprehending arrest in connection with Halem P.S. Case No. 02/2023, under sections 420/406/468/471/506 of IPC, this application under section 438 Cr.P.C., Page No.# 2/3 has been preferred by the accused petitioner namely, Sri Ratna Basnet, for granting pre-arrest bail.

It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is in a good relation with the complainant and complainant advised the accused petitioner to get an experience certificate and accordingly, the present accused petitioner obtained the certificate from the concerned authority and it was handed over the complainant but subsequently, it has came to the knowledge of the Ratna Basnet vs The State Of Assam on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/161982321/
1 complainant that it was fake certificate for which the present F.I.R. was lodged.

entities.text: Ratna Basnet vs The State Of Assam
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is further submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is not aware of the issue of the fake certificate and he obtained the same on bonafide believe that the said certificate was genuine.

The learned counsel for the petitioner further submits that the petitioner is ready to co- operate with the investigation of the case, if he is enlarged on interim pre-arrest bail and so that he can also appeared before the I.O. for recording his statement etc.
In this regard the learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State of Assam has raised no objection against the prayer of the accused petitioner.
Considering, the submission of learned counsels for both sides as well as nature of the allegations, I find it is a fit case where the privilege of interim pre-arrest bail can be granted.

Accordingly, in the event of arrest, the accused petitioner namely, Sri Ratna Basnet is granted interim pre-arrest bail on furnishing a bail bond of Rs. 20,000/- (Rupees Twenty Thousand only)
with a suitable surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting authority in connection with aforementioned case till receipt of the case diary.

The interim bail is granted on the following conditions:
Page No.# 3/3 1.
That the petitioner shall make himself available to the police or any other investigating agency or Court in the present case as and when required.

2. That the petitioner shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
He shall not, in any manner, try to overawe or influence or intimidate the prosecution witness.
3. That the petitioner shall not misuse his liberty in any manner.
In the mean time I.O is directed to produce the up to date case diary on the next date.
List the matter on 27.02.2023.
